notes.title: Demo 4.3.0 is available for download
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27817245/68c4a72e90fc565c1e6f21ca0be9e770a35ce842.png[/img]

Soon game is going to be out on Steam (please, add to wishlist!). So I very much like to know that I didn't break anything during the last year of work. Please let me know if anything is odd.

In updated demo:

1. Characters are reworked, old ones conflicted with game's visual style

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27817245/1ddcc84b3f57bdc653079567363cee7d6c4ec257.png[/img]

2. More compact and informative user interface

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27817245/bf5aec72f871c56be5674d1d34661de60468fc26.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27817245/30d2433723a18baee17e98a93bc17ca9f6b8946a.jpg[/img]

3. New level with mites for teaching player sharp turns

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27817245/0954eb4a451d03db053514c9b879f73c1f931942.png[/img]

4. New balance: other system for calculating food value, even easier worm moving, new worm AI

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27817245/2cde16a9ec797efd1836a7d0a7e624bbc9f2e191.jpg[/img]

5. Archivements and secrets: console cheat codes are legal now, every archivement reveals something new

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27817245/dc372af9ca5d93b99426ba5c706b40ef08b50ac6.jpg[/img]

This yellow face means achievements and transition to a new level are temporarily blocked due to cheats.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27817245/e9cc7f0fd62e7bf21b28c2793661bb886b6a50bb.png[/img]

6. Two test levels for split screen mode (with teleports and helmets)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27817245/255d2bdf3a5ad527be9e131fcb058d0b437c2774.png[/img]

7. Somewhere in the end of the demo you can play with laser beam and ride acid worm!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27817245/60a3dd0f0f4653251d21cc24c91afc38f8377693.png[/img]

Download link: [url=https://insatia.kozinaka.com/download/en]https://insatia.kozinaka.com/download/en[/url]
